assist.defaultTitle: Uses the default connection from Settings.

beginner.label: Beginner level
beginner.text: Adjust it to explain at the level of someone who is just starting out.

concise.label: More concise
concise.text: Tighten the instructions so they are shorter and more concise. Keep the core rules.

example.label: Add an example
example.text: Add one output example the model can follow.

format.label: Clarify output format
format.text: Define the output format (headings, lists, tables, length) more clearly.

quiz.label: Concept quiz
quiz.text: Give it a topic and it quizzes you on 5 key concepts, with answers folded away so you can check yourself.

simple.label: Explain simply
simple.text: A skill that explains hard concepts so a middle schooler could follow, using analogies and visual examples.

socratic.label: Socratic dialogue
socratic.text: A skill that asks questions instead of answering right away, so the learner reaches the answer on their own.

vocab.label: Vocabulary
vocab.text: A skill that helps you memorize English words with meanings, example sentences, etymology, and easily confused words.

assist.noAi: No AI connection is available. Check your connections in Settings.
assist.notConnectedPc: You are not connected to a PC. Connect to the PC first.
assist.parseFailed: Couldn't read a skill from the AI response. Try rephrasing your request.
assist.placeholderEdit: Describe how to change it. e.g. Make it 3 review questions and organize them in a table.
assist.placeholderNew: Describe the skill you need. e.g. A skill that explains code line by line when you give it some code.
assist.running: AI is writing… the fields below fill in as it goes.
assist.viaPcTitle: Writes using the PC remote settings (agent, model, effort).

extras.duplicatePath: A file with the same path already exists.
extras.filesHint: Keep long reference material in {references}, example code in {scripts}, and answer templates in {assets} to keep the instructions short. Files are passed to the model along with the instructions when this skill is used.
extras.setHint: Questions where this skill is selected are answered with the settings above. Later questions follow the session settings again. Leave model and effort empty to use that connection's defaults.
extras.textOnly: {name}: only text files can be added.
extras.unsetHint: If left empty, the provider, model, and effort chosen in the chat session are used. Pick them to have only this skill answer with a different model.

files.count: You can add up to {n} files.
files.duplicate: Two files have the same path.
files.path: File paths can only be relative paths made of English letters, digits, Hangul, ., _ and - (e.g. references/guide.md; SKILL.md is not allowed).
files.size: Each file can be up to {file} characters, and the total up to {total} characters.

page.existingHint: Type {command} in the chat input or pick it from {menu}, and the instructions below will be added to that question.

page.saveFirstMessage: The folder is created when you save the skill, and you can open it after that.

page.syncOffline: You can sync once connected to the PC
page.syncReady: Pull skills created on the PC
page.syncSame: PC skills are already up to date.
